note: The Banking Law, article 105a(3) and (5): after a contract ends, a bank and BIK may keep a person's data without consent where a payment was more than 60 days late and 30 days have passed since the person was told, for at most five years from the obligation's end; written as reported 90 days after the due date.

sources.title: Ustawa Prawo bankowe, tekst jednolity Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1646 (Kancelaria Sejmu, as of 2025-12-09)
